Record Class ScalaFieldData

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.scala.processing.visitor.ScalaFieldData
Record Components:
name - The field name
type - The field type
annotations - The annotations
modifiers - The modifiers
enumConstant - Whether this field is an enum constant
constantValue - The compile-time constant value, if any
nativeType - The native Scala compiler object
genericType - The type with the declaring type's variables bound, or null when it is the declared one
All Implemented Interfaces:
ScalaAnnotatedElementData

    • equals

      public boolean equals(Object other)
      A declaration is itself: two are equal only when they are the same object. Record equality would compare every member, type and annotation beneath, and core keeps these as keys of a hash map -- so every lookup was hashing the whole model of the class.
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
